recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一顆大細胞，胞質豐富且深藍嗜鹼性、帶細小空泡，內有四個大小不一的圓形核、染色質呈塊狀；深藍胞質配多核，是多核（發育異常樣）漿細胞，本例為 AML 鞏固治療後的反應性變化。
features: Large cell with abundant, deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing fine vacuoles
Four separate round-to-oval nuclei of unequal size
Coarse, clumped chromatin; no conspicuous nucleoli
Cytoplasmic outline irregular, with no distinct perinuclear hof in this plane
Background of maturing granulocytes (myelocytes, bands, segmented neutrophils) and a small lymphocyte
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large multinucleated cell with abundant, deeply basophilic, finely vacuolated cytoplasm and four round nuclei of variable size with coarsely clumped chromatin. The morphology is that of a pleomorphic multinucleated plasma cell. The background shows orderly granulocytic maturation without increased blasts in this field. Although multinucleation raises concern for a plasma cell neoplasm, it can occur in reactive or regenerating marrow; in a patient after AML consolidation, the findings are consistent with a reactive atypical plasma cell, and clonality should be assessed by kappa/lambda staining or flow cytometry if plasma cells are increased.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with pleomorphic plasma cells
ddx.vs: Myeloma shows increased, often clustered plasma cells with light-chain restriction and a serum/urine M-protein, which cannot be judged from a single cell.
Osteoclasts are much larger with many (often >10) uniform, well-separated nuclei and pale, granular pink-blue cytoplasm rather than a few unequal nuclei in deep blue cytoplasm.
Megakaryocytes have granular lilac cytoplasm and are CD61-positive, not deeply basophilic cytoplasm with plasma cell-type chromatin.
Carcinoma cells typically occur in cohesive clusters with fine chromatin and prominent nucleoli rather than as a single cell with clumped plasma cell-type chromatin.
